thomas_kilmann_conflict_modes.description: Thomas-Kilmann Conflict Mode Instrument (TKI) — maps negotiation and conflict-resolution styles along two axes: assertiveness and cooperativeness

modes.description: Win-lose; power-oriented. Pursues own concerns at other's expense.
Win-win; explores disagreement to find creative solutions.
Split the difference; expedient middle ground.
Yields to other's point of view; selfless generosity.

rogers_diffusion_of_innovations.description: Technology Adoption Lifecycle — classifies adopters by their willingness to try new innovations

categories.description: Venturesome; first to adopt. Tolerate high uncertainty.
Opinion leaders; visionary. Embrace change for strategic advantage.
Deliberate; adopt before average. Need proven results.
Skeptical; adopt after majority. Need peer pressure or necessity.
Traditional; resist change. Only adopt when no alternative.

cialdini_influence_principles.description: Robert Cialdini's 6 Principles of Influence/Persuasion — framework for engagement strategy

principles.description: People feel obligated to return favors
principles.engagement_tactic: Offer free audit, capability assessment, or technical consultation before asking for business

principles.description: People want to be consistent with prior commitments
principles.engagement_tactic: Get small commitments first (NDA, plant tour, technical review) before larger asks

principles.description: People look to others' actions to determine correct behavior
principles.engagement_tactic: Reference similar companies, competitor adoptions, industry benchmarks

principles.description: People defer to experts and authority figures
principles.engagement_tactic: Lead with certifications, technical expertise, published papers, patents

principles.description: People prefer to say yes to people they like
principles.engagement_tactic: Find common ground (alma mater, hometown, shared interests), use referrals from known contacts

principles.description: People value things more when they're scarce
principles.engagement_tactic: Emphasize limited capacity, time-sensitive opportunities, exclusive capabilities

kahneman_prospect_theory.description: Prospect Theory (Kahneman & Tversky, 1979) — explains decision-making under risk and uncertainty

key_parameters.description: Losses are felt ~2.25x more strongly than equivalent gains

apexintel_application.risk_tolerant_pois: Frame proposals as gains (upside potential, new revenue, competitive advantage)
apexintel_application.risk_averse_pois: Frame proposals as loss prevention (avoid supply disruption, prevent quality escapes, maintain compliance)

batna_negotiation_framework.description: Best Alternative to a Negotiated Agreement (Fisher & Ury, 'Getting to Yes')

concepts.description: Best Alternative To a Negotiated Agreement — your walkaway option
concepts.apexintel_use: Assess POI's alternatives (other suppliers) to gauge negotiating leverage

concepts.description: Zone Of Possible Agreement — range where both parties can agree
concepts.apexintel_use: Map Starz capabilities vs POI requirements to find overlap

concepts.description: Minimum acceptable outcome before walking away
concepts.apexintel_use: Estimate from POI's budget signals, historical contract values

concepts.description: First offer sets the frame for negotiation
concepts.apexintel_use: Prepare recommended first-offer positioning per POI profile

big_five_ocean_traits.description: Big Five personality traits (OCEAN model) — the dominant psychometric framework in psychology

traits.apexintel_mapping: Maps to decision_style (high C → ComplianceFirst or QualityFirst)
Maps to negotiation_profile (high A → Collaborative, low A → Competitive)

disc_profile_mapping.description: DISC personality model — maps behavioral tendencies for workplace interactions

profiles.communication_preference: Be brief, focus on bottom line, present options
Be friendly, allow time for socializing, show enthusiasm
Be patient, provide assurance, clarify expectations
Provide data, be accurate, allow time for analysis

cultural_dimensions_hofstede.description: Hofstede's Cultural Dimensions — critical for ApexIntel's multi-region POI engagement (TN/MA/IL/CN/JP/KR/EU/US)

engagement_implications.high_power_distance: Respect hierarchy; approach top-down. Titles and formal address matter (TN, MA, CN).
engagement_implications.low_power_distance: Flatter structure; direct approach acceptable (IL, US).
engagement_implications.high_uncertainty_avoidance: Need detailed specs, contracts, certifications upfront (JP, KR, IL, FR).
engagement_implications.low_uncertainty_avoidance: More comfortable with ambiguity; pilot projects over formal RFPs (CN, US).
engagement_implications.collectivist: Group consensus decisions; relationship networks critical (CN, KR, JP, TN, MA).
engagement_implications.individualist: Individual decision-makers; direct ROI arguments (US, FR).
engagement_implications.long_term_oriented: Emphasize long-term partnership, investment horizon (CN, JP, KR, DE).
engagement_implications.short_term_oriented: Emphasize quick wins, immediate ROI (TN, MA, US).

seniority_scoring_reference.description: Role seniority weights used in influence scoring — calibrated against HR/organizational behavior research
